function statement(sql,args=[]){return {bind(...values){return statement(sql,values)},async all(){return {results:sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...args)}},async first(){return sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...args)||null},async run(){const r=sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...args);return {meta:{changes:Number(r.changes)}}}}}
const bucket=new Map();globalThis.__pllugoTestEnv={PLLUGO_OWNER_EMAIL:'owner@example.test',DB:{prepare:sql=>statement(sql),async batch(statements){sqlite.exec('BEGIN');try{const r=[];for(const s of statements)r.push(await s.run());sqlite.exec('COMMIT');return r}catch(e){sqlite.exec('ROLLBACK');throw e}}},BUCKET:{async put(key,body,options={}){bucket.set(key,{body,...options})},async head(key){return bucket.get(key)},async get(key){return bucket.get(key)}}};

for(const file of files){let source=await readFile(file,'utf8');source=source.replace(/import \{env\} from 'cloudflare:workers';/g,'const env=globalThis.__pllugoTestEnv;').replace("import source from './source-routines.json';",'const source='+await readFile('lib/source-routines.json','utf8')+';');source=source.replace(/from '([^']+)'/g,(m,p)=>{if(!p.startsWith('.'))return m;return "from '"+pathToFileURL(join(temp,resolve(root,dirname(file),p).slice(root.length+1)+'.mjs')).href+"'"});const output=ts.transpileModule(source,{compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ES2022}}).outputText;const dest=join(temp,file.replace('.ts','.mjs'));await mkdir(dirname(dest),{recursive:true});await writeFile(dest,output)}
const load=f=>import(pathToFileURL(join(temp,f.replace('.ts','.mjs'))).href);

function req(path,body,headers=owner,method=body?'POST':'GET'){return new Request('https://app.example.test'+path,{method,headers:{...headers,...(body?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{})},...(body?{body:JSON.stringify(body)}:{})})}
async function success(r){assert.ok(r.ok,`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.clone().text()}`);return r.json()}
async function create(name,role,unit){return success(await users.POST(req('/api/users',{name,email:name.toLowerCase()+'@pllugo.test',role,units:[unit],active:true})))}
async function login(email,password){const r=await auth.POST(req('/api/auth',{action:'login',email,password},{}));await success(r);return {cookie:r.headers.get('set-cookie').split(';')[0]}}
async function change(headers,password){const r=await auth.POST(req('/api/auth',{action:'password',password},headers));await success(r);return {cookie:r.headers.get('set-cookie').split(';')[0]}}
